text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
We're heeeere!
Today I'm taking care of you, Pops, so you don't have to lift a finger!

text_block_list.name: Pops
text_block_list.text: It gladdens me to see you in such high spirits, but endless worry is simply the nature of an old butler's heart.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Geez! I told you, it's totally fine!
Leave everything to me! Come on, let's go!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: I planned out our entire hot spring tour route, so just follow my lead, Pops!

text_block_list.name: Pops
text_block_list.text: I see, a route devised by Milady herself, is it...?

text_block_list.name: Pops
text_block_list.text: Far from calming down since childhood, her boundless mischief has only evolved further. I must prepare myself for what lies ahead—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Pheeewww...
Feels so nice~... How about you, Pops~?

text_block_list.name: Pops
text_block_list.text: Indeed... It is unexpectedly relaxing... and I find myself quite astonished...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right! Hey, Pops, Pops,
I'll give you a massage while we're at it!

text_block_list.name: Pops
text_block_list.text: A-A massage from Milady...!?

text_block_list.name: Pops
text_block_list.text: (It feels like only yesterday when young Milady proclaimed herself a chiropractor and ran wild all over this old back of mine... I must brace myself.)
(*tap, tap, tap*)

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, your shoulders are a bit stiff, Pops.
How's around here~?

text_block_list.name: Pops
text_block_list.text: Ahhh... Most astonishingly... it is remarkably comfortable...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: They have delicious hot spring carrots here! Let's eat, let's eat~!

text_block_list.name: Pops
text_block_list.text: Yes, yes, I shall accompany you, Milady. I have braced myself to be dragged along to the ends of the earth, after all—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: I'll go buy them, so you just sit on that bench, Pops!

text_block_list.name: Pops
text_block_list.text: ! What in the world—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Here ya go, sorry to keep you waiting! I grabbed some drinks while I was at it too. Let's take our time and eat here!

text_block_list.name: Pops
text_block_list.text: ............Milady. To think I would receive such thoughtful consideration from you...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ehh? Why are you so surprised!
I've been smart and mature for a long time now, you know?

text_block_list.name: Pops
text_block_list.text: No, knowing Milady, I fully expected you to unleash your wild nature once more and sprint around proclaiming to conquer every single bath.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: *gasp*...

text_block_list.name: Pops
text_block_list.text: Just the other day, you swam all over the large public bath at our relative's house until you overheated, causing quite a commotion. Truly, you remain as much of a tomboy as ever—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Geez! The past is in the past!
Today isn't like that at all!
I told you, today is about treating you, Pops!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: ...Pops, you've always taken care of me, played with me, and worked so hard for my sake ever since I was little, right?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: You listened to so many of my selfish requests, and I dragged you around all over the place.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Pops, you always kept up with my pace and stayed right by my side. That always made me so happy!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
So now it's my turn! I'm matching Pops' pace!
That's why I planned everything today.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
—Thank you for everything, Pops.
Please stay healthy forever.

text_block_list.name: Pops
text_block_list.text:
Milady—
............You truly have grown up so splendidly...

text_block_list.name: Pops
text_block_list.text: Yes, indeed. This old servant has no intention of stepping down for a successor just yet. I shall remain in Milady's service for many long years to come.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for the advice the other day!
Here, have some hot spring carrots as thanks.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Trainer from back then!
Thank you too, your advice was super helpful~!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Trainer from back then!
Thank you too, your advice was super helpful~!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Yup, huge success! Pops was saying stuff like "You've grown up so much~" and got totally emotional.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Seriously, I'm such a great grandkid and a wonderful milady, aren't I~!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Me?
...Yeah, I had a blast.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Since enrolling in the Academy, the time I get to spend with Pops went down a lot. Getting to chat with him tons after so long... made me super happy!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Oh yeah, Trainer, here's a thank-you gift for you too—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: ...Oops. I don't have enough.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: —Oh, Pops? About those souvenirs from the hot spring the other day, turns out I don't have enough. Pops, could you go buy some more for me?
Watching her casually unleash her selfish demands on him made me understand Pops' plight all too well... and I couldn't help but chuckle wryly.
